Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding expediting appeals to the shoreline hearings board and the pollution control hearings board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to expediting appeals to the shoreline hearingsboard and pollution control hearings board; adding a new section tochapter 43.21B RCW; adding a new section to chapter 90.58 RCW; anddeclaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21B RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A party to an action before the pollution control hearings boardmay request of the governor an expedited appeal. The governor maygrant the requesting party an expedited appeal at the governor'sdiscretion, if an expedited appeal would best serve the publicinterest. In an expedited appeal, the pollution control hearings boardmust conduct all proceedings and issue a written decision within thirtydays of the governor granting the request. The pollution controlhearings board may adopt rules for practices and procedures toimplement this section under RCW 43.21B.170.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A party to an action before the hearings board may request of thegovernor an expedited appeal. The governor may grant the requestingparty an expedited appeal at the governor's discretion, if an expeditedappeal would best serve the public interest. In an expedited appeal,the hearings board must conduct all proceedings and issue a writtendecision within thirty days of the governor granting the request. Thehearings board may adopt rules for practices and procedures toimplement this section under RCW 90.58.175.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
